scenes.title: Hook: date and place
scenes.purpose: [hook-date] Date and place stamped on the surface with the first image visible.
scenes.why: Places the story in time and space.
scenes.visual: Ruled sheet with a hatched Earth; date stamp; place typed; title rises; grain boils.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Setting: the Earth-Moon chart
scenes.purpose: [setting] The establishing chart, labelled and marked not to scale.
scenes.visual: Moon draws; labels; the outbound route draws.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Event run: the log
scenes.purpose: [event-run] Each log line types while the marker keeps pace on the chart.
scenes.visual: Five log lines type in turn; the marker rides out, the orbit draws, the site marks, the return route draws.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Turning point: the landing
scenes.purpose: [turning-point] Slow push into the landing site.
on_screen_text: Eagle sets down in the Sea of Tranquility.
scenes.visual: Push 2.6x into the Moon; the log line highlights; header fades; caption on a paper band.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Close: the whole sheet
scenes.purpose: [close] Pull back with the date range and source.
scenes.why: Closes on the whole sequence and its source.
on_screen_text: 8 days, 3 hours, 18 minutes · Source: NASA mission record
scenes.visual: Pull back to the whole sheet; date range rises; duration and source type.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.
